source.sqlReaderQuery:
select 
'Num' as Num,
'CustomerNumber'as CustomerNumber,
'SalesOrg'as SalesOrg,
'DistributionChannel'as DistributionChannel,
'Division'as Division,
'HigherCustomerNumber'as HigherCustomerNumber,
'HigherSalesOrg'as HigherSalesOrg,
'HigherDistributionChannel'as HigherDistributionChannel,
'HigherDivision'as HigherDivision,
'HierarchyAssignment'as HierarchyAssignment,
'HierarchyType'as HierarchyType,
'ValidFrom'as ValidFrom,
'ValidTo'as ValidTo,
'CustomerName'as CustomerName,
'RAW_DATA_ACT_STATUS'as RAW_DATA_ACT_STATUS,
'RAW_DATA_UPDT_TS'as RAW_DATA_UPDT_TS,
'BACH_NUM'as BACH_NUM,
'SRC_SYS_CD'as SRC_SYS_CD,
'SRC_SCM_NM'as SRC_SCM_NM,
'SRC_FIL_NM'as SRC_FIL_NM,
'SRC_FIL_DIR'as SRC_FIL_DIR,
'REC_CRT_DT'as REC_CRT_DT,
'REC_EFF_DT'as REC_EFF_DT,
'REC_EXP_DT'as REC_EXP_DT,
'INA_FLG'as INA_FLG,
'DT'as DT,
'EXP_FLG'as EXP_FLG
union all
-- select * from (
select 
str(Num) as Num,
-- convert(varchar,Num) as Num,
CustomerNumber,
SalesOrg,
DistributionChannel,
Division,
HigherCustomerNumber,
HigherSalesOrg,
HigherDistributionChannel,
HigherDivision,
cast(HierarchyAssignment as nvarchar) as HierarchyAssignment,
HierarchyType,
ValidFrom,
ValidTo,
CustomerName,
cast(RAW_DATA_ACT_STATUS as nvarchar) as RAW_DATA_ACT_STATUS,
cast(RAW_DATA_UPDT_TS as nvarchar) as RAW_DATA_UPDT_TS,
cast(BACH_NUM as nvarchar) as BACH_NUM,
cast(SRC_SYS_CD as nvarchar) as SRC_SYS_CD,
SRC_SCM_NM,
SRC_FIL_NM,
SRC_FIL_DIR,
REC_CRT_DT,
REC_EFF_DT,
REC_EXP_DT,
cast(INA_FLG as nvarchar) as INA_FLG,
DT,
EXP_FLG
 from (
select row_number() over(order by CustomerNumber ) as Num,
*
from (
select 
CustomerNumber,
SalesOrg,
DistributionChannel,
Division,
HigherCustomerNumber,
HigherSalesOrg,
HigherDistributionChannel,
HigherDivision,
cast(HierarchyAssignment as nvarchar) as HierarchyAssignment,
HierarchyType,
ValidFrom,
ValidTo,
CustomerName,
cast(RAW_DATA_ACT_STATUS as nvarchar) as RAW_DATA_ACT_STATUS,
cast(RAW_DATA_UPDT_TS as nvarchar) as RAW_DATA_UPDT_TS,
cast(BACH_NUM as nvarchar) as BACH_NUM,
cast(SRC_SYS_CD as nvarchar) as SRC_SYS_CD,
SRC_SCM_NM,
SRC_FIL_NM,
SRC_FIL_DIR,
REC_CRT_DT,
REC_EFF_DT,
REC_EXP_DT,
cast(INA_FLG as nvarchar) as INA_FLG,
DT,
EXP_FLG
From [MVIEW].[MIC_CustomerHierarchy]
where SalesOrg in('CN23','CN14') and DistributionChannel='01'
)t 
)a
-- order by Num asc
-- )
